summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend verification of IntownPA. Created pytest suite covering auth (OTP), RBAC, customer booking + approval signature flow, PA lifecycle (accept/options/receipt/variance/POD), admin (overview/assign/verify PA/pricing), full end-to-end customer->admin->PA->customer completion with rating, payments placeholder (create-order + simulate-success), chat messages, and notifications. 30/30 executed tests pass (2 skipped due to one-time seeded state already consumed on repeated runs). Frontend smoke tested: dev OTP auto-fill works, Priya/Admin/Ravi logins succeed, admin stat cards render, customer multi-step booking produced a TOWN- task (TOWN-704974) with correct cost estimate, task detail shows Products tab + Show Me Before You Buy banner, PA Tasks shows offered + active with Accept/Decline.

issues: Toast 'Add a task title' appeared on Review step though title was filled on an earlier step; likely stale validation but booking still succeeded. Low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: Payment simulate-success is correctly guarded by cfg['enabled'] false in placeholder mode - good.
routes_payment.create-order ignores body.amount from client (good: server computes amount from task) - consider documenting pay_for enum validation (currently accepts any string, defaults to fees).
routes_pa.update_status allows 'delivered' but customer confirm-delivery also sets 'completed'; both paths covered.
Dev OTP leaks via dev_otp field only when MOCK_OTP enabled - acceptable for dev; ensure MOCK_OTP_ENABLED=false in prod.
CORS set to '*' with allow_credentials=True in server.py - browsers will reject credentials with wildcard; harmless in current token-in-header auth but should be tightened for cookies.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md: Admin 9999900000, Customer Priya 9876543210, PA Ravi 9000000001 (verified), PA Anil 9000000002 (pending). OTP always 123456 and dev_otp returned by send-otp.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_-prefixed tasks (TEST_Groceries, TEST_variance, TEST_E2E, TEST_PlaywrightBooking) and new signup user 9123456780 (TEST_New). Note: during admin test run, the seeded pending PA 'Anil Reddy' (9000000002) was verified via /api/admin/pas/{id}/verify. If a re-seed/reset is desired for next run, re-run seed to restore 'pending' state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_intownpa.py and is pytest-xdist-safe (uses shared tokens fixture, scoped session). All critical flows wired. If re-seeding is needed, note that /api/admin/pas/{id}/verify expects body {"action":"verify|reject|suspend|activate"} (NOT {"approved":true}). /api/payments/simulate-success expects {order_id, payment_id} - task_id is derived server-side from the payment record. /api/tasks/{id} returns {task, options, timeline, receipts, pa} (key is 'options', not 'product_options').
